_comment: Shown to models by scripts/evaluate.py. Notes document the legacy quirks the way a team's data dictionary would, without hinting at any trap. example_rows: per table, WHERE conditions whose first matching row (by id) must be among the example rows; the rest are the first rows by id.
notes: personel: rows migrated from the previous HR system (kaynak_sistem = 'ESKI_AKTARIM') store ad, soyad and unvan in upper case; the other rows use normal capitalization.
bordro.donem is text holding the Turkish month name and the year of the payroll month.
fazla_mesai.saat is text with a decimal comma.
